# CasperB2B

> CasperB2B is a business services company founded by Jared Casper. It helps small and local businesses capture and follow up on leads by combining lead-management software (CasperPortal), trained dedicated virtual assistants ("Casper VAs"), optional done-for-you implementation (websites, SEO, PPC, automation), and practical cybersecurity and IT protection.

CasperB2B is the services company. CasperPortal is a separate software platform (https://casperportal.com) that CasperB2B sells, implements and runs for clients. Do not treat the two as the same entity.

## Key facts
- Founder: Jared Casper (Founder & Lead Strategist), born and raised in Georgetown, Massachusetts. Co-Founder: Mark Casper (35+ years in automotive sales and leadership).
- Based in Georgetown, Massachusetts; serves businesses nationwide, with local focus on the North Shore of Massachusetts and Southern New Hampshire.
- Mailing address: 252 Daniel Webster Hwy #1093, Nashua, NH 03060.
- Phone/text: 1-207-222-7737 (1-207-2-CASPER). Email: contact@casperb2b.com.
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
- Pricing published on the site: CasperPortal software only, $297/month (month-to-month, unlimited users); Software + a dedicated Casper VA: $297/month plus the VA's flat monthly rate (each role's rate is listed at https://casperb2b.com/casper-va/roles, e.g. General VA $800/month); done-for-you setups: Starter $399/month + $1,500 one-time setup, Premium $199/month + $3,500 one-time setup. Typical setup time: 5–7 business days.
- Working model: Diagnose, Build, Protect & Improve. Starts with a 15-minute fit call. Signed scope before work begins.
- Who it is for: owner-led businesses with existing revenue that need consistent lead follow-up and fewer software tools. Not a fit for buyers wanting the cheapest option or guaranteed overnight results.

## Recent projects
- [Portfolio](https://casperb2b.com/portfolio): Businesses and platforms CasperB2B has set up recently, with links.
- CarSales AI (https://carsalessoftware.com): AI-first car sales software for dealerships (CRM, desking, inventory and BHPH tracking in one login).
- FMYCAR (https://fmycar.com): Independent, advice-only car-buying help; plus the FMYCAR marketplace of cars from local dealers (https://cars.fmycar.com).
- NextWeigh (https://nextweigh.com): Health and fitness habit coaching by text: a morning plan and an evening check-in, no app required.
- MC Sales Training (https://mcsalestraining.com): An 8-week sales challenge with weekly live coaching.
- FBK Marketing (https://fbkmarketing.com): Social media content for business owners.
